# Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays.")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2-dimensional matrices.")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All inputs must have the same shape.")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if n_candidates == 0 or future_horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices cannot be empty.")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values.")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive.")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean.")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a scalar.")
    tau = float(tau_filter)
    if np.isnan(tau) or np.isinf(tau) or tau < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number.")

    # Compute means
    mean_with = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    mean_call = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    mean_no = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute improvements
    improvement_result = mean_with - mean_no  # L_no - L_with
    improvement_call = mean_call - mean_no    # L_no - L_call

    # Margin is the minimum improvement
    margin = np.minimum(improvement_result, improvement_call)

    # Keep if margin > tau
    keep = margin > tau

    return keep, margin
